summary: The count of who graduated starts when a class starts ninth grade, not when it finishes.
realLife: The adjusted cohort graduation rate follows first-time ninth graders and counts those who earn a regular diploma within four years.
sources: NCES, Fast Facts: High school graduation rates: https://nces.ed.gov/fastfacts/display.asp?id=805
inGame: the people module's life records, read by lifeOf in src/bench/loading.ts (school/finished, the year the diploma came).

turns.what: The student leaves without a diploma, and the cohort count shows them as not finished.
turns.writesBack: no school/finished record; the no-diploma talk plays

turns.what: The diploma comes in the fifth year, after an illness or a move.
turns.writesBack: a finished record one year late
